bio.text: Jimmy Gazaway is serving his fifth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 31.
A native of Paragould, he has been an attorney in private practice there since 2006 and was a deputy prosecuting attorney for the Second Judicial District from 2008 to 2017.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Arkansas State University in 2003 and a law degree from the UA Little Rock Bowen School of Law in 2006.
